notes: ConditionalsIMD (COND) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin v5.4.0 ERC20 in src/ConditionalsIMD.sol. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 COND (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, 18 decimals) exactly once to msg.sender, which on the launch is the factory; there is no other mint path, so the supply can never grow. Transfers are plain: no fee, burn, tax, reflection or hook, so the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the single-sided seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager, claims from the distributor and trades in the pool all move exactly the amount requested, and the token needs no exemption list and none of the launch placeholders. There is no owner or admin role and no pause, blacklist, freeze, seize, burnFrom, mint, upgrade or proxy; only a holder, or a spender the holder approved, can move a holder's balance. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT and links no external library. No application contracts are deployed with this token. The pool pairs COND with IMD at the launch policy's fee and tick spacing; initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
